context: A mom and son chat at bedtime
purpose: Teach: ひも/かみ/召/満席/離し/後々/本心/願い事

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、靴のひも、結べるようになった!
lines.en: Mom — I can tie my shoelaces now!
lines.style: Bright burst of pride. Quick pace, almost tumbling over the words. Immediate and unselfconscious. The joy of a small victory announced before it can be forgotten.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: すごいわね。お風呂で、かみを洗ってあげるね。
lines.en: That's wonderful. I'll wash your hair in the bath.
lines.style: Genuine warmth underneath. Light, present tone — not effusive but solid. A quiet acknowledgment of the milestone before moving into the next small thing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Polite but uncertain. Careful phrasing — he's trying the grown-up words. Slight hesitation, like he's checking if he said it right. Hopeful undertone.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祭り、満席で、入れなかったわね。
lines.en: The festival was full — we couldn't get in.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, tinged with dry acceptance. Not complaining, just stating. A small sigh woven through it. The tone of someone used to adjusting plans.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お友達の手、離した時、寂しくなった。
lines.en: When I let go of my friend's hand, I felt lonely.
lines.style: Quiet and wondering. Spoken like he's noticing this feeling out loud for the first time. Soft, almost to himself. No drama — just honest observation of something small that mattered.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 後々、いい思い出になるのよ。
lines.en: Someday it'll become a good memory for you.
lines.style: Gentle certainty. Speaking from experience. Slow, measured pace. The tone of someone reassuring not with false comfort but with quiet knowledge. A hand on his shoulder in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 本心、まだ、ちゃんと言えないけど、頑張る。
lines.en: I can't say how I really feel yet, but I'll try.
lines.style: Determined but small. Careful, thoughtful pace. He's choosing his words. The effort is in the voice — not struggling, just concentrated. Looking up when he says it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 願い事、たくさん書いて、七夕にね。
lines.en: Write lots of wishes for Tanabata.
lines.style: Warm invitation. Gentle push into possibility. Open pace, inviting him in. The voice of someone who believes wishes matter and wants him to believe it too.
